sources.title: Watch: Leaked photos reveal extensive damage at US bases in Gulf

items.title: Leaked Photos Show Extent of Iranian Strikes on US Gulf Bases
items.body: Leaked photos provided by active military personnel depict a devastated U.S. presence in the Gulf. A severed radar jet, flattened trailers and heavily damaged buildings are clear evidence of recent Iranian strikes on American bases.

sources.title: Improving HCLS AI reasoning with open-source agent skills

items.title: Open‑Source Skills Close the Reasoning Gap for Health‑AI Agents
items.body: AI agents built on foundation models often misapply health‑care decision frameworks even when they have the guidelines in front of them. A collection of 38 open‑source agent skills now supplies structured reasoning for 11 health domains, helping agents win 70‑86 % of head‑to‑head tests and closing the silent‑failure gap. The skills are packaged as markdown SKILL files, covering everything from genomics to claims operations.

sources.title: NASA’s Moon Orbiter Spots New, ‘Once-in-Century’ Moon Crater

items.title: Orbiter Captures Once‑in‑Century Crater on the Moon
items.body: Robert Wagner spotted a bright patch with a dark halo while checking a lunar map made from NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter images. Comparing older and newer images revealed McGetchin, the largest newly formed crater yet found in the solar system. A rock estimated to be the size of a three- to six-story building struck between April 11 and May 22, 2024, leaving a crater 728 feet wide. Scientists estimate an impact of that scale occurs on the Moon about once a century or less often.

sources.title: Handbags, jewels, watches: Inside Singapore's dirty money auction

items.title: Singapore Seizes $2.2 B in Luxury Goods for Money‑Laundering Auction
items.body: Singapore police have moved $2.2 billion worth of illicit cash into the spotlight, seizing a trove of handbags, jewels and watches that are now on display inside a fortified storage facility for an upcoming auction. The case underscores the city‑state’s aggressive stance against high‑value money‑laundering operations.
